notes: fast: the xUnit project compiles Core/**/*.cs directly, so it needs no MAUI workload and runs in seconds.
full: CI's test matrix (Debug and Release). The MAUI build is not run here: CI's build.yml runs it on every PR and it is a required check (D9).
reviewOnReady: claude-code-review.yml runs once, on ready_for_review (A6); the review skill waits for it and triages its comments.
fileTools is empty on purpose: there is no per-file C# linter in the repo; the tests and CI's build catch compile errors.
docmap is empty until concept links that no path reveals are known.
